summary: Saved ArcRho JSON files now keep triangles and other row arrays on one line per row, so a DFM method file stays readable after a Save instead of reverting to one value per line.
details: One writer in arcrho_api/io.py now owns the on-disk layout for method, sidecar, index, dataset type, reserving class, and project-data JSON.
The app server, public Python API, ResQ migration, and bridge previously formatted the same file three different ways; they now emit identical bytes.
A 40-origin DFM method drops from about 1,900 lines and 30 KB to 170 lines and 13 KB, and reads back slightly faster.
Files without a two-dimensional array are unchanged on disk, and method revisions are unaffected.
